_comment: Small, fast settings for a testbed: tiny battles, short waits, no Steam.

pool._comment_offline_after_p2p: A player-hosted server heartbeats from the menu page, which is inside the game process: it stops sending entirely while the engine loads a level, so this has to survive a changelevel, not just a network hiccup.

war._comment_weight: A battle is worth its size: full_strength_players is the headcount that clears a whole stage, min_battle_weight the floor under a thin one. Small here because a testbed is four people, not twelve.

timing._comment_session_timeout: Long enough to cover a map load: a client in the middle of one is not polling, and dropping it there would take it out of the battle it is loading into.
